Name: SmartNPC Beta
Author: donst0ne
Description:
Smart NPC Beta - Detailed Description

Overview
Smart NPC Beta is a dynamic dialogue enhancement mod for Stardew Valley that revolutionizes how NPCs interact with players. This mod brings Shane to life with context-aware conversations that respond to time of day, weather conditions, and your friendship level with him.

Core Features

Time-Based Dialogue
Experience different conversations throughout the day:
- Early Morning (6:00-10:00)**: Shane's grumpy morning mood
- Late Morning (10:00-14:00)**: More neutral, reflective conversations
- Evening (14:00-24:00)**: Different evening perspectives

Weather-Responsive Dialogue
Shane's personality shifts with the weather:
- Rainy Days: Calmer, more philosophical conversations
- Regular Days: His typical cynical and distant demeanor
- Dynamic reactions to how weather affects his mood

Friendship Level Integration
Your relationship with Shane influences his responses:
- Low Friendship (0-3): Dismissive and cold interactions
- Medium Friendship (4-7): Warming up, showing interest
- High Friendship (8+): Genuinely glad to see you, more open conversations

How It Works
The mod uses ContentPatcher to seamlessly integrate dialogue entries into Stardew Valley's dialogue system. No complex configuration needed - simply install and play!

Installation Requirements
- Stardew Valley v1.6 or higher
- SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) v4.0+
- ContentPatcher v2.0+

Current Status: BETA
This is the initial release focusing on Shane's dialogue system. Future updates will include:
- Expanded dialogue for more NPC characters (Abigail, Haley, Sebastian, etc.)
- Seasonal dialogue variations
- Additional conditions (skill levels, romance stages, festivals)
- Expanded time intervals for more dynamic interactions
- Integration with other mod systems

Compatibility
- Fully compatible with other dialogue mods (install order may vary)
- Works with Content Patcher v2.0 and above
- No conflicts with gameplay mods
- Can be combined with other character enhancement mods

Performance
Extremely lightweight - minimal impact on game performance.

Support & Feedback
Found a bug or have suggestions? Your feedback helps improve this mod! Report issues and suggestions to help shape future updates.

Future Roadmap
- More NPCs with full dialogue systems
- Seasonal content variations
- Holiday-specific dialogues
- Expanded friendship interactions
- Romance path enhancements

Version History
v1.0.0 Beta (2026-04-19) - Initial Beta Release
- Shane dynamic dialogue system
- Time-based responses
- Weather-dependent conversations
- Friendship level integration
